cues: Pedaling turns the rear wheel, converting a commuter’s effort into forward motion along quiet streets.
A low frame lets children mount easily while learning balance and steering in a paved park.
Handlebars give the rider precise control when navigating crowded paths and making sharp turns.
A chain transfers leg power to the rear sprocket, helping carry groceries home without fuel.
A lightweight frame makes uphill trips manageable and encourages short errands without a car.
Reflective strips improve visibility at dusk, helping people travel safely along roads after sunset.
A kickstand keeps the parked machine upright while its owner locks it beside a storefront.
A basket above the front wheel carries books to school while leaving both hands on the grips.
